notes: Thesis §V: a rerating is a shift in the MODEL MIXTURE — a company migrating from being priced on one frame to being priced on another — and it frequently occurs with little or no contemporaneous cash-flow news. "When a price move cannot be explained within the current model mixture, but can be explained with shifted weights, the system has likely caught a rerating in progress. The residual stops being merely unexplained variance and becomes a structured hypothesis test over which weights moved."
